def contour_points(mask):

  c=np.vstack([c,c[0]]);d=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(c,axis=0),axis=1))]

  out.append(np.stack([np.interp(t,d,c[:,k]) for k in range(2)],1))
 return out

def build():

"""Build and execute acrylic region-contour strokes for the frozen Blue Horses scene."""
import os,time,json,numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter1d
from rcb_brush import Session
BASE='/app/output'

def resample(path,step=1.25):
 path=np.asarray(path,float)
 d=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(path,axis=0),axis=1))]
 sel=np.r_[True,np.diff(d)>1e-8];d=d[sel];path=path[sel]
 t=np.linspace(0,d[-1],max(2,int(np.ceil(d[-1]/step))+1))
 out=np.array([np.interp(t,d,path[:,k]) for k in range(3)]).T
 # A little corner smoothing removes sudden acceleration without changing the shape materially.
 out=gaussian_filter1d(out,.45,axis=0,mode='nearest')
 out[0]=path[0];out[-1]=path[-1]
 return out

def run():
 data=np.load(BASE+'/paths.npz',allow_pickle=True)
 s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json',render=False);p=s.primitives();s.record_start();color=None;t0=time.time()
 for idx,(c,path) in enumerate(zip(data['colors'],data['paths'])):
  c=int(c);path=np.asarray(path,float)
  if c!=color:
   pos=s.tip_pose()[0];pos[2]=.06;p['move_tip'](pos,speed=.15,settle=2)
   x,y=s.wells()[c]['center_xy'];p['move_tip']([x,y,.06],speed=.20,settle=3)
   p['move_tip']([x,y,.023],speed=.06,settle=4);p['move_tip']([x,y,.055],speed=.10,settle=3)
   color=c
  x,y=s.geo.mm_to_world(*path[0,:2]);z=.02-path[0,2]/1000
  p['move_tip']([x,y,.045],speed=.20,settle=3)
  p['move_tip']([x,y,z],speed=.045,settle=5)
  qprev=s.ik([x,y,z])[0]
  rs=resample(path)
  for v in rs[1:]:
   x,y=s.geo.mm_to_world(*v[:2]);q,ok,err=s.ik([x,y,.02-v[2]/1000],q_init=qprev)
   if not ok:raise RuntimeError(('IK failure',idx,err))
   s.step(q+1.7*(q-qprev));qprev=q
  p['set_joint_targets'](qprev,steps=3)
  pos=s.tip_pose()[0];pos[2]=.045;p['move_tip'](pos,speed=.09,settle=3)
  if idx%10==0 or idx==len(data['colors'])-1:
   Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(BASE+'/canvas.png')
   print('progress',idx+1,'/',len(data['colors']),'steps',s.n_steps,'elapsed',round(time.time()-t0,1),flush=True)
 acts=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(acts,BASE+'/trajectory.npz')
 Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(BASE+'/canvas.png');np.save(BASE+'/ink.npy',s.ink())
 print('sha',s.state_sha(),'strokes',len(s.strokes()),'actions',len(acts),flush=True)
 print('SCORE',s.score(),flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':run()
